sources.title: Nursing Home Discharges, Transfers, and Room Changes: Know Your Rights (LTC Discharges Brochure) — Nevada Aging and Disability Services Division, Long Term Care Ombudsman Program
sources.notes: Supplement captured 2026-09-25 for the dead reader link on the Nevada page. The standing packet's source 9 address, https://www.adsd.nv.gov/uploadedFiles/adsdnvgov/content/Programs/Seniors/LTCOmbudsman/LTC%20Discharges%20Brochure(2).pdf, now answers HTTP 301 to this address (ADSD moved its uploaded files under /siteassets/); the division's own Long Term Care Ombudsman page still links the old address, which redirects here. The link published on roomandrecourse.com was also broken for a second, unrelated reason: tools/render-state.py ends a markdown link target at its first ')', so the published href stopped at 'Brochure(2' and returned 404. The brochure's text is unchanged: pdftotext -layout of this file matches the standing packet's source 9 body line for line, apart from trailing whitespace and the page-break form feed. This supplement exists so the reader-facing address the page now links is itself captured evidence.
